== Description ==

[[Nathan Davis]] (left, back to camera, navy Mariners GRIFFEY 24 jersey, blue Seattle cap, black shorts), [[Karl Koenig]] (standing right of that pair, yellow graphic tee, black shorts with white stripes), [[Joe Phillips]] (seated mid-right at a table, white stormtrooper/saber graphic tee, black long sleeves, name tag starting “Jo”), [[Brian Fred]] (seated behind Joe Phillips, bald, glasses, grey-white beard, black tank, arms crossed), and [[AJ Hatoum]] (standing right of Brian Fred, light brown/blond hair, glasses, black graphic tee, name tag starting “A”, brown watch) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
